rows.en: Touya: "...There's something I've been wondering about.
Your family..."
Arthur: "..."
Yamato: "Touya... You shouldn't really ask about things like that..."
Arthur: "Well... It's not something I need to hide,
so I don't mind. But why do you ask?"
Touya: "Isn't wanting to know you better a good enough reason, Arthur?"
Arthur: "...I'm afraid I don't have those inclinations...
I'm perfectly normal..."
Touya: "Huh?"
Arthur: "Oh, no, forget I said that.
Yes, my family.
But... It isn't a very pleasant story, you know."
Touya: "Isn't there something troubling you... No, something unpleasant
about it?
That's how it looked to me back then."
Arthur: "Hehe... I suppose you did notice after all.
Yes, you're right. As I said before,
my mother now is my father's second wife, and my younger brothers
are their children.
But that stopped bothering me a long time ago.
The problem is my own birth... That's what troubles me."
Yamato: "Your birth...?"
Arthur: "My father isn't my biological father."
Touya: "What?!"
Arthur: "My biological father was the president of the company
my father used to work for... It was before my mother married my father.
I was born with both of them in agreement,
and my father loved me as though I were his own son.
So I have no complaints about that,
and I believe I was happy."
Arthur: "But my biological father...
I can never forgive that man..."
Yamato: "Arthur..."
Arthur: "When he learned my mother was pregnant,
his attitude changed completely, and he began treating her coldly.
In the end, he even claimed it must be another man's child
and forced my mother to leave her job..."
Arthur: "My father worked at the same company. He couldn't stand
seeing his colleagues keep quiet out of fear of the president,
so he protested. But that angered the president,
who retaliated by harassing him and putting pressure on him.
Finally, he made my father stand out in the street under the blazing sun
for eight whole hours..."
Yamato: "That's awful..."
Touya: "But why did he obey an order like that?
Couldn't he have refused?"
Arthur: "My father is an upright man. Whatever harassment he faced,
he would meet it head-on and endure it.
So even then, as people laughed at him in the street,
he kept standing there.
And that crowd even started affecting traffic.
Eventually, my father and the president's treatment of him
came to the attention of the police."
Touya: "And that was the end of it... Except it wasn't, was it?"
Arthur: "No. Even when the police questioned him, he remained calm
and declared that my father was at fault for defying him. When asked what he would do
if he were ordered to do the same thing,
he said, 'If I had to do it, I would. But I have
no need to do anything like that.'"
Touya: "What a bastard... Human scum..."
Yamato: "Touya!"
Touya: "Oh... S-Sorry..."
Arthur: "...No. He deserves to be thought of that way.
In the end, he got away with a small fine, and my father
left the company too. My parents married soon afterward."
Touya: "And then Arthur was born..."
Arthur: "Yes. Until my mother died of illness when I was five,
the three of us
were a very happy family."
Touya: "...Wait. Did you know back then, Arthur,
about your own birth?"
Arthur: "No. I learned everything after my mother died
and my father, who had stayed single, married my mother now.
She was my mother's best friend and had lost her husband early,
but she used to look after me a lot,
and I loved her. So when I learned she had feelings for my father,
I supported their marriage.
My father seemed to care about her too.
More than anything, I wanted my father to find happiness of his own...
Then they married, my younger sister was born, and around the time the elder of my younger brothers was born,
I heard about my father from the mother I have now.
To be precise, I overheard her talking to my father...
That was the first time in my life I hated another person.
No, I even felt a clear desire to kill him..."
Touya: "..."
Arthur: "I went straight to his company
and met him. He admitted everything.
He was grinning... I felt everything before my eyes
turn red. And then... He had no remorse,
no regret, and I punched him so hard he went flying...
It was the first time I'd ever hit another person.
And to think that person was my biological father...
It's hardly a funny story, is it?"
Touya: "Arthur..."
Arthur: "If my father hadn't stopped me then, I might have
killed him. When my father hit me for the first time,
I realized how foolish I'd been.
My father should have been the one
who was truly furious... And yet I let my own emotions
dictate my actions...
I'd been causing my father trouble all along.
So ever since then, I've made sure not to see that man
and devoted myself to protecting my family.
Because there was a small but warm happiness there..."
Touya: "I see... You've got a good dad..."
Arthur: "Yes. The best father anyone could have."
Touya: "Family... Family isn't just about blood,
is it? The bond between your hearts is what matters most."
Yamato: "Touya..."
Arthur: "Yes. That's why, honestly, I want to go back
to my family as soon as I can... Those are
my true feelings."
Touya: "Then we've got to settle this fight here for that too."
Arthur: "Yes. I'm counting on you."
Touya: "Cut it out. You're embarrassing me."
Arthur: "Hehehe... Well, that's the end of my story.
Are you satisfied?"
Touya: "Yeah... I understand you a lot better now, Arthur."
Arthur: "I'm glad to hear that.
I'll take my leave, then."
Yamato: "Arthur's been through a lot too..."
Touya: "Yeah. Everyone's had their own troubles."
Yamato: "We've got to do our best, meow."
Touya: "Yeah."
Arthur: "...I'm sorry."
Touya: "I see... All right.
Sorry for prying."
Arthur: "No, I don't mind.
But why do you ask about something like that?"
Touya: "Your eyes."
Arthur: "My eyes...?"
Touya: "You looked like you were hurting. That's how it felt to me."
Arthur: "..."
Touya: "Well, I hope I just imagined it.
See you..."
Arthur: "...Not yet..."
Touya: "I see. Sorry to keep asking.
But when you're ready, will you tell me?
I might not be much help, though."
Arthur: "Yes... When I'm ready..."
Touya: "See you."
